source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "F2" when the hint shows up during POST. Check the information and see if SUT could boot into BIOS setup menu.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. POST information (include BIOS version and release date) should be readable and correct.
2. SUT should boot into BIOS setup menu successfully.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical pre-OS dependency.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds board-specific F2 mapping, version/date and recovery evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify the board-specific F2 POST hotkey opens BIOS Setup and that BIOS version and release date shown during the path are readable and correct.
original_method: Confirm F2 is the documented Setup key for this board/BIOS, use a physical keyboard/display in an approved boot window, capture the hint, timed F2 action and resulting Setup/version/date, then exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must press F2 during POST and visually verify the exact Setup screen and version/date. Agent inventory cannot prove this hotkey-specific path.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS identity and documented F2 behavior
safety_requirements: Do not assume F2 behavior from another platform or accept OS inventory as hotkey evidence.
Drain workloads before the boot interruption.
Do not flood keys or modify BIOS settings.
Stop on wrong menu, unreadable values or failed exit/recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare baselines, expected values and capture checklist.
Analyze supplied images/video and correlate boot/BMC context.
Report evidence without claiming manual action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve boot window and press F2 at the shown hint.
Observe/capture correct Setup menu and version/date.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: SSH cannot perform or prove F2 pre-OS behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain physical F2 interaction; no software substitution.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F2, hint timing, BIOS Setup, version/date and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: HUMAN F2 PATH WITH CONTINUOUS EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a continuous timestamped sequence from board-specific F2 hint through Setup entry and version/date, then safe exit.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Boards documenting F2 as Setup entry on the tested console.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC build, keyboard/display and capture method.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds board-specific mapping and traceable capture without changing the manual core.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote KVM injection is only equivalent when the project explicitly tests that path.

project_override_considerations: Remote KVM may be an approved console override, but must not be silently treated as physical keyboard coverage.
expected_evidence: Safe exit and normal boot evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All source fields consistently define F2 Setup entry and displayed information.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear; manual equipment/reference needs are readiness inputs.
